Container.Name: Caretaker-Hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Moonlight/Apollo companion: wake a Windows gaming PC (Wake-on-LAN), unlock the lock screen from your phone, and sleep it when you are done. LAN-only — do not expose to the internet.
Container.Requires: Host networking is required so Wake-on-LAN and agent discovery (UDP 7843) reach your LAN. Keep this container off the public internet — use Tailscale/WireGuard if you need remote access. See SAFETY.md in the project repo.
Container.Description:
Caretaker Hub runs on your Unraid box and talks to a small Windows agent on your gaming PC.
After install: 1. Open http://TOWER:8080 (or your Unraid IP) and sign in with the UI password you set below. 2. On the Windows PC: Hub → Setup → Download installer → run as Administrator. 3. Pair the PC from Nearby PCs, then Wake / Unlock / Sleep from your phone.
Defaults use host networking and listen on port 8080. If something else already uses 8080, change CARETAKER_PORT and edit the WebUI URL in Advanced View to match.
Not malware, but privileged: anyone who can log into the Hub can wake, unlock, and sleep paired PCs. Full details: https://github.com/TRU5T/caretaker/blob/main/SAFETY.md

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Hub config (password hash, hosts, pairing codes).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port on the Unraid host (host networking). If you change this, also edit the WebUI URL under Advanced View.

Config.Name: UI Password
Config.Description: Hub login password. Used only on first start (when config.json is created). Pick something strong — default in the image path is changeme if left empty.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: HMAC secret for the session cookie. Generate once (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32) and keep it. Changing it signs everyone out.
